name: Google Cloud (GKE) Plugin
description: Signs in to Google Cloud (gcloud auth login) for the nodes of a GKE cluster, in a terminal.

actions.title: Sign in to Google Cloud for this cluster (gcloud auth login)…

settings.label: Extra variables for commands and terminals
settings.help: One NAME=value per line, added to the environment of the kubectl and helm commands, the terminals Klotse starts and Klotse's own connection for a cluster, for example CLOUDSDK_ACTIVE_CONFIG_NAME=work. Saved as plain text in the settings file: do not put secrets here. Klotse's own connection to the cluster gets them too (the kubeconfig's sign-in helper), and they are never written to the kubeconfig or logs.

cluster_settings.label: Cloud of this cluster
cluster_settings.help: Set this when the cluster's nodes do not report their cloud in the providerID (a local emulator, a custom node pool). auto uses the providerID check; gcp accepts this cluster's nodes without it.
